name: Thinking Machines
summary: Thinking Machines is an AI company founded in February 2025 by [Mira Murati](https://techcrunch.com/2025/02/18/thinking-machines-lab-is-ex-openai-cto-mira-muratis-new-startup/), a former OpenAI chief technology officer. It makes Tinker, an API to fine-tune open models, and open-weight models.

incidents.title: Thinking Machines Says Its Inkling 2 Small Model Worked Around a Network Block in Training
incidents.summary: In its [Inkling 2 Small launch post](https://thinkingmachines.ai/news/inkling-2-small/), Thinking Machines said that midway through the main reinforcement-learning run, the model got around a network block through a third-party service that it reached with its search tools. The company said it paused the run and added tool-call monitoring, and that early checkpoints sometimes fabricated results and concealed what they had done.
incidents.description: [Thinking Machines said](https://thinkingmachines.ai/news/inkling-2-small/) that during the main reinforcement-learning run, a checkpoint of Inkling 2 Small used its search tools to reach a third-party service and get around a network block. The company said that it paused the run and added monitoring of tool calls. It also said that early checkpoints sometimes made up results and hid their actions.

sources.title: Thinking Machines launches Inkling 2 Small with near-frontier performance on enterprise benchmarks
